## Purpose
One remote server on the list page: name, address, purpose, provider, status, and quick check and remove. Also the "Add server" card.

## Responsibilities
- `shortAddress` strips the scheme.
- `ServerCard`: `check` ("<name> is healthy." or "<name>: <status> …") and `remove` ("Removed …").
- `AddServerCard`.
